leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom React hook to manage session timeout logic
Initialize state variables to track user activity and remaining time
Implement event listeners to detect user interactions and reset the timer
Configure a countdown mechanism that updates the remaining time display
Integrate the session timeout hook into a functional React component
Render visual feedback based on the session timeout state (active, warning, expired)
Manipulate the DOM to show/hide timeout warnings and session expiration messages
